q: The spectral decomposition theorem for Axiom A diffeomorphisms decomposes the non-wandering set Ω into:
opts: A countable collection of fixed points
Finitely many disjoint T-invariant basic sets, each topologically transitive
The union of all periodic orbits
exp: Smale's spectral decomposition: Ω = Ω₁ ∪ … ∪ Ωₖ (finite, disjoint, invariant, locally maximal hyperbolic sets on each of which T is topologically transitive).
